summary: Comprehensive frontend E2E testing completed for HomeCart. All 14 critical user journey flows verified end-to-end: login (admin@homecart.com/admin123), home creation, weekly list creation, adding items in Groceries & Vegetables categories, basket comparison rendering 6 vendors with BEST badge highlighted in orange (BigBasket as best deal in test), price comparison modal showing 6 vendor cards, catalogue add, item completion toggle, WhatsApp share popup, item deletion, archive list, and logout redirect to /login. All data-testid selectors present and accessible.

issues: Accessibility warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` on DialogContent. Add DialogDescription component or aria-describedby for a11y compliance.

action_items: Minor (a11y): Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to all DialogContent components in Dashboard.js modals (CreateHome, JoinHome, CreateList, AddItem, PriceComparison) to silence React a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js is 772 lines - consider splitting into smaller components (HomeSidebar, ShoppingList, BasketComparison, modal components) for maintainability per 700-line guideline.

Duplicate data-testid `category-groceries/vegetables/medicines` in Dashboard (used in both list category headers and AddItem modal). Tests must use .last/.first to disambiguate. Recommend renaming modal testids to `modal-category-*`.
WhatsApp share URL `https://wa.me/?text=...` works correctly. WhatsApp's server redirects wa.me to api.whatsapp.com/send - this is expected behavior, not a bug.
Initial 401 errors on /api/auth/me before login are expected (cookie-based auth check) but could be suppressed in console for cleaner UX.
Header home-switch button cycles via `homes.find(h => h.home_id !== selectedHome.home_id)` - works only for 2 homes; for 3+ homes user can't reach all. Consider proper dropdown.
seed_data_creation: Created via UI during test: Home 'Test Home Smith' (HOME-6C586AB5), 1 Weekly list with 2 items (Basmati Rice 5kg Groceries, Tomato 2kg Vegetables). List was archived at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 features from the review request verified working. Backend already passed 12/12 in iteration 1. Frontend journey: login → create home → create list (Daily/Weekly/Monthly) → add item (with 3 categories) → basket comparison (6 vendors, BEST highlighted) → compare prices modal (6 vendors) → toggle complete → catalogue add → WhatsApp share → delete → archive → logout - ALL working. Only minor a11y warning about DialogContent missing aria-describedby. Note: PriceComparison vendor links go to Google search (mock) - this is by design per the mocked API note. Best deal accent color #FF6B35 correctly applied to BEST badge and border.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. WhatsApp 'wa.me/?text=' URL is generated correctly in code; the browser shows api.whatsapp.com/send URL because wa.me is a WhatsApp shortlink that redirects server-side - expected behavior, not a bug.
